description: This file is a shell script that implements a test suite for verifying Git clone command behaviors under various URL formats and options. It defines setup procedures, test cases, and expected outcomes for cloning repositories with different URL structures, including SSH, HTTPS, and local paths.

methods.name: test_clone_dir
methods.description: A function to test cloning a repository from a given URL into a specified directory, with optional flags for failure and bare modes. It performs cleanup, executes the clone, and verifies the existence of the target directory.
